description: This Java class 'ServiceSynchronization' manages transaction-bound service executions, registering services to run upon transaction commit or rollback, and executing them asynchronously or synchronously during transaction completion.

classes.name: ServiceSynchronization
classes.description: Manages registration and execution of services upon transaction commit or rollback, ensuring services are run in appropriate transaction context.

classes.name: ServiceExecution
classes.description: Represents a service to be executed after transaction completion, handling execution logic including async/sync invocation and transaction management.

methods.name: registerCommitService
methods.description: Registers a service to be executed upon transaction commit.

methods.name: registerRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a service to be executed upon transaction rollback.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton ServiceSynchronization instance associated with the current transaction.

methods.name: afterCompletion
methods.description: Executes registered services after transaction completes, based on commit or rollback status.

methods.name: beforeCompletion
methods.description: Placeholder for pre-completion logic (empty in this implementation).
